clips.title: 净利暴跌75%：阿里美国市场却由跌转涨，市场在赌什么？
title_lines: 阿里美国市场却由跌转涨

subtitles.en: Well, Alibaba's U.S. Mr. Chair swung from losses to a narrow game after it reported a first-quarter profit plunge of more than 75 percent. The Chinese take giant also increased capital spending
subtitles.zh: 阿里巴巴美国市场盘前由跌转涨，此前公布第一季度利润暴跌逾75%。这家中国电商巨头还增加了资本支出，

subtitles.en: to almost $10 billion, aiming to safeguard its position in a fiercely competitive global AI arena. Let's bring our China correspondent Min Lo in Hong Kong with the later. So how are we
subtitles.zh: 接近100亿美元，旨在捍卫其在竞争激烈的全球AI领域的地位。我们连线驻香港的记者Min Lo，了解最新情况。

subtitles.en: seeing the above a fairing in this broad environment? Yes, well, its revenue was up about 90 percent
subtitles.zh: 在当前环境下，阿里巴巴表现如何？是的，其营收增长约90%，

subtitles.en: or so, but the concerning thing for investors is a net income which plunge, as you said, 75 percent.
subtitles.zh: 但市场参与者担心的是净利润，如你所说，暴跌75%。

subtitles.en: This is on the back of very strong investment into AI, which this quarter hits close to $10 billion. Now, you consider that $10 billion in a quarter. That's an analyzed rate of about
subtitles.zh: 这源于对AI的强劲**，本季度接近100亿美元。想想看，一个季度100亿美元，年化支出约400亿美元。

subtitles.en: $40 billion of spending. And this tracks far above the company's guidance earlier. They initially said they were spending over $50 billion in three years when it comes to CAPEX. So they are spending
subtitles.zh: 这远超公司早前的指引。他们最初表示三年内资本支出将超过500亿美元，但现在支出远超这一水平。

subtitles.en: a lot more than that. And the CEO Eddie Wu has blamed this on memory costs because the cost of setting up a server has now doubled because of that, he said. So when you look at its earnings breakdown,
subtitles.zh: CEO吴泳铭将此归因于内存成本，因为服务器搭建成本因此翻倍。看其盈利构成，

subtitles.en: you take a look at that free cash outflow increased by 100 over percent compared to the previous year.
subtitles.zh: 自由现金流流出同比增加超过100%。注意，这是负的现金流。

subtitles.en: So that is a negative cash outflow, mind you. So overall, if you break down its business segments cloud has been showing a lot of potential with its revenue accelerating to a 45 percent growth.
subtitles.zh: 总体来看，分业务看，云业务展现出巨大潜力，营收加速增长45%。

具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
